plan.expectedWallClock: About 12–14 minutes including real loading, eight reading pauses, end/return/resume/next and two keepsake previews.
plan.clock: Native autoplay at rate 1; no fake time. Only the encounter UI may make its own small seek to the authored encounter target. Round two starts through the real replay button.
plan.urlPolicy: Classify snapshot/letter URLs using actual toBlob metadata. Stable HOME/VIEWER: at most one unreleased snapshot per chapter, <=4 total. During transitions, older URLs retained by active DOM/loading consumers are counted separately. Browser document teardown is not reported as explicit URL.revokeObjectURL calls.
plan.audioPolicy: One actual AudioContext, exactly three cumulative looping source starts; incidental one-shot cues are separate. Reading -6dB measured on native music gain, then restoration.
plan.memoryScope: Actual optional performance.memory JS heap, CDP JS heap and DOM counters, application texture-byte estimate. None is VRAM or a whole-process memory measurement; no forced GC and no monotonic-memory leak verdict.
plan.binding: Frozen production bundle plus selected lifecycle/source-clock/snapshot/audio core hashes. Unrelated CSS/report edits do not invalidate core binding. Native pixel fidelity remains separate.
